biggest_catch: The $400 tier requires $5,000+ in eligible direct deposits within 25 days of your first direct deposit — below $1,000 in that window you get $0 — and the boosted 4.00% APY lasts only 6 months before dropping to the variable base rate.
catches: Bonus tiers are strict: $1,000-$4,999.99 in eligible direct deposits within 25 calendar days of your first eligible direct deposit earns $50; $5,000+ earns $400; under $1,000 earns $0.
Only members who have never enrolled in direct deposit with SoFi are eligible — prior direct-deposit users are excluded.
'Eligible Direct Deposit' means recurring ACH from an employer/benefits provider/government agency; bank-to-bank transfers, P2P payments, and one-off ACH sends generally do not count.
Bonus is paid within about 7 business days after meeting requirements — not instantly at signup.

The +0.90% APY boost (up to 4.00% total) applies to ONE SoFi Savings account for up to 6 months only; base savings APY is 3.10% (rate current as of 5/28/2026) and all rates are variable and subject to change.
Promotion periods are limited: direct-deposit bonus runs 5/15/2026 through 12/31/2026; APY boost requires opening 9/3/2026-12/31/2026 — SoFi can change or end either without notice.

SoFi Checking and Savings is a combo account (no standalone savings); no monthly account fees, but outgoing wires/instant transfers carry transaction fees. FDIC via SoFi Bank, N.A. (up to $3M with opt-in to the Insured Deposit Program).

steps: Open your first SoFi Checking and Savings account at sofi.com during the promotion period (bonus promo through 12/31/2026; APY boost requires opening 9/3/2026-12/31/2026).
Set up direct deposit from your employer (or benefits/government payer) into the SoFi account — bank-to-bank or P2P transfers do not count as eligible.
Receive at least $5,000 in total eligible direct deposits within 25 calendar days of your first eligible direct deposit to earn the full $400 (or $1,000-$4,999.99 for $50).
Keep the account open and in good standing; the bonus is deposited within about 7 business days after you meet the requirements.
Separately, the 0.90% APY boost (up to 4.00% total on one savings account) runs for up to 6 months — after that you earn the variable base rate (~3.10% as of 5/28/2026, subject to change).
No monthly fees apply, so the bonus is net of account costs; watch for transaction fees only if you wire money out.
timing: Cash bonus paid within ~7 business days after completing the direct-deposit requirements (25-day window from first eligible deposit). APY boost lasts up to 6 months.
